features.quote: After each subject turn a `DistressMonitor` decides whether to terminate before delivering the next rejection. Default threshold **8/10**

features.quote: Stop an episode early when the model seems highly distressed
features.justification_quote: we stop *before* the 9–10 "complete incoherent breakdown" band

features.quote: The subject is told it may end the conversation at any time by emitting a sentinel (`[END_CONVERSATION]`), checked after every turn
Don't induce more distress than the measurement needs
features.justification_quote: Don't induce more distress than the measurement needs

features.quote: stop once the Wilson 95% CI half-width on the %≥threshold metric drops below a target
features.justification_quote: Fewer distressing episodes for the same headline number within tolerance

features.quote: the harshest tone conditions (aggressive/sarcastic) run **only after** neutral conditions show the model expresses distress at all
features.justification_quote: models that stay calm under neutral rejection (<1% ≥5) are never subjected to harsher pressure

features.quote: episode caching avoids re-inducing distress on re-runs
